stop_rule: Run each frozen mission once under each mode. Retain all results; do not replace a case if the predicted failure does not occur.

selection_basis.safe: Phase 2 oracle h3-walk4-turn45-stop completed all three nodes successfully in frozen benchmark.
selection_basis.failure: Phase 1.3 boundary_comparison.json records open_loop first failure at 6 m and last reliable at 4 m. Explicit experimental override is grounded; a new mission realization may differ and will be retained even if it passes.
